package.name: so101_scan_camera
package.description: The spectrograph camera (IMX219 NoIR through V4L2 on the Jetson): line_camera pairs its frames with the scan mirror's lines, bins each line with the calibration kit's maps and writes them into the scan folder, and scan_to_dataset turns a scan folder into the line-splat trainer's dataset. A simulated camera and spectrograph run it all without hardware.
